subject: Dedicated Demo: Finly - throughput & latency requirements
messages:
-----Original Message-----
From: Samir Shah <samir@finly.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-10T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for production throughput

Hi Aditya,

We just finished a self-serve test on Redwood's hosted API and are seeing promising accuracy, but our infra team is concerned about per-request latency and sustained throughput for our peak batch scoring. We're evaluating Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and want to schedule a demo to dive into latency SLOs, autoscaling, and quantization options. Key numbers:

- Concurrent QPS target: 120 rps
- Typical sequence length: 512 tokens
- P95 latency target: <250ms

Can we set up a 45–60 minute call next week? Prefer afternoons PST.

Thanks,
Samir Shah
VP of Engineering, Finly

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@finly.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-01-10T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for production throughput

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and for trying Redwood. I'm Aditya on the SDR team — happy to coordinate. Marissa (cc'd) runs demos for Dedicated and will take you through throughput/latency tradeoffs.

Can you do one of the following slots?
- Tue Jan 12, 2:00 PM PST
- Tue Jan 12, 4:00 PM PST
- Wed Jan 13, 11:00 AM PST

I'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-demo questionnaire so our engineers can prepare. Also looping in Dev from Solutions (cc).

Best,
Aditya
Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@finly.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-10T12:25:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Inquiry: Dedicated capacity for production throughput

Hi Samir — great to meet you. Thanks for sharing the targets. Tue Jan 12 at 2:00 PM PST works for our team; I've tentatively scheduled a 60-minute demo and invited Dev to cover architecture + quantization recommendations.

Prep for the call:
- Please fill out the attached pre-demo questionnaire (finly_pre-demo_questionnaire.pdf) with sample payload sizes and expected concurrency patterns.
- If you can share an anonymized throughput trace or a short sample of typical requests, that will let us model batching and KV cache behavior.

Agenda (60 mins):
1) Intro + scope (5m)
2) Production goals & constraints (10m)
3) Serving runtime: autoscaling, batching, quantization, kernel selection (20m)
4) Deep-dive: throughput/latency modeling for 512-token workflows (20m)
5) Next steps & mutual action plan (5m)

Attachments: finly_pre-demo_questionnaire.pdf, mvp_capacity_estimate.xlsx

Thanks — I'll follow up with the calendar invite and a HubSpot deal link.

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Shah <samir@finly.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-01-12T14:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Dedicated Demo: Finly - throughput & latency requirements

Hi Marissa — thanks for scheduling. Unfortunately a client escalation came up and I need to move the call. Can we push to Wed Jan 13 at 11:00 AM PST instead? Apologies for the last-minute change. Priya (our infra lead) will join at the new time.

Samir
